title: Agent version contract
description: Response body of GET /agents/{id}/versions/{v}. Published versions are immutable. This is a response schema, so objects are open: the platform may add fields and clients must ignore unknown ones.

owner.description: Team or user that maintains the agent.

status.description: deprecated: still executable, designer shows a warning and blocks new pins. disabled: executions rejected with AGENT_VERSION_DISABLED.

input_schema.description: JSON Schema (2020-12) for the execution request's input.

output_schema.description: JSON Schema (2020-12) the platform guarantees the output conforms to.

model.description: Informational only. Shown read-only in the designer's About tab.

digest.description: sha256 over the RFC 8785 canonical JSON of {input_schema, output_schema, limits}. Model details are excluded so the digest tracks only what callers depend on.
